manifestations.invariant: When a germination sampling result fails after its tray is sealed and shipment portions exist, the lot is quarantined, the portions are recalled, and its class quota is released exactly once.

contract_bindings.quote: Each germination sampler reservation consumes a class quota before the sampling tray is sealed.
A failed lot enters quarantine; the recall record lists recalled shipment portions after its class slot is released.
